spec.hypothesis: Type confusability (BCS) independently predicts extraction degradation in MAVEN Event Detection, replicating Few-NERD finding cross-task (NER→ED). Analysis focus: pairwise + per-type (not batch-level due to BCS compression).
spec.design: exp1: count curve {1,6,12,24,42,84,168} x 5 random; exp2: count={12,24} x 27 batches. Qwen3 BCS matrix. 149 active types. Analysis: Layer 1 pairwise SCS-confusion + Layer 2 per-type F1 vs mean SCS + Layer 3 batch-level percentile rank BCS.
spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/schema-dag-extraction && python3 src/run_experiment.py --dataset maven --mode exp1 ... && python3 src/run_experiment.py --dataset maven --mode exp2 ..."

experiment_data.notes: MAVEN BCS study RUNNING. Reviewer 发现 Qwen3 BCS 在 MAVEN 上范围极度压缩（同域 event types，max pairwise sim ≥0.90）。分析计划调整：(1) 重点做 pairwise confusion (Layer 1) + per-type F1 vs mean SCS (Layer 2)，这两层在 BCS 压缩下仍有效; (2) batch-level 用 percentile rank BCS 替代原始值; (3) 不换 embedding 模型——Qwen3 = extraction model，方法论一致性优先; (4) BCS 压缩本身是 finding：同域 type space 下 LLM 难区分 → SDGD 价值更高。
